plan: This is a second-price auction format where the winner pays the second-highest bid, not their own bid. In this format, bidding your true value is the dominant strategy - it's weakly optimal regardless of what others bid. If I bid higher than my value, I risk winning and paying more than the item is worth to me. If I bid lower, I risk losing auctions I could have profitably won. Since my value is $28, I should bid exactly $28 to maximize expected profit.
